warning.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover TDV6 Timing Chain & Injector Wear
paragraphs: If your Range Rover is a pre-2022 model with the TDV6 or SDV6 diesel V6 — that's the L322 or L405 generation — timing chain tensioner wear and injector seal failure is a well-documented pattern on this engine, backed by Land Rover specialist consensus and multiple independent garage sources. We replace the timing chain, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every TDV6 and SDV6 rebuild.

The current L460-generation Range Rover uses a different engine family (Ingenium I6), which doesn't share this specific issue — it's a separate, more recent design with its own occasional DC-DC converter concerns flagged for MHEV variants, but nothing as consistently documented as the older engine's timing chain pattern.
warning.source: Source: extremely well-corroborated across Land Rover specialist forums and independent garages, per VRF-landrover-range-rover.md. L460 Ingenium variants explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to generation
